nodes.label: Feature-Based Folder Structure Convention
nodes.rationale: Prescribes that each feature owns its own components/constants/hooks folders, reusable pieces move to shared src/components or src/hooks, and cross-feature component imports are disallowed — intended to keep features decoupled and prevent naming collisions.

nodes.label: Folder Optimization Progress Checklist
nodes.rationale: Checklist of folders already migrated to the feature-folder convention (sidebar, three, canvas, code-detail, code-sidebar, data-type-container, function-definer, functions-container, help-modal, import-export, log-container, project-sidebar, renderer, runner-definer, startup-page, variable-container). Unverified: most listed names (three, canvas, renderer, runner-definer, startup-page, etc.) do not correspond to any folder under the current src/features tree (which only has code-editor, response-panel, sidebar, tweaks) — this list appears to be carried over from a prior/different project structure rather than reflecting this repo.
